text: ＊は　＊で　じめんタイプの　わざが　あたらない！

structure.jp: じめんタイプの　わざが

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can give the reason something happens. ＊で = 'because of ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ない on the end of a verb says the action does not happen. あたらない = 'does not hit'.
